description: Hand-written expected Compare Quotes marks (slice 6, R7 + R12/D13) for each eval run of these fixtures (tests/eval/eval_adapter.py LIVE_RUNS). Written from what the fixtures print, never computed by compare_rules. The gate compares them with the marks in the run's artifact response; any missing, extra or different worse/best mark is a hard fail. Synthetic sample data.
